description: `@r.lo = 9` (hi 2) and `@r = { lo: 9, hi: 5 }` both break `Range`'s `lo <= hi` and trap before the write: r stays { lo: 1, hi: 2 }.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5: "A deep write (`@trip.range.end = x`) checks every enclosing invariant whose read set holds the path"; a genuine replace is checked (O58: "the invariants apply to it as to every write").
